scope: Isolated emitted native/full Sound instruments, desktop DPR1 and mobile DPR2 at CPU1/4. Eight-second stories exercise complete original instruments with actual running AudioContexts, trusted activation, interrupted caller holds, queued Reset and resume. Audio is redirected to an inaudible MediaStream; speaker connections are rejected. Real RAF intervals, long tasks, first paint, readiness and CDP traces are recorded. Fonts are prepared before mounting; state is read only at endpoints. Physical input and exact original synthesis/PCM are verified separately. Public route transfer and final timing gates remain open.

checkoutLineEndings.policy: Measured source hashes bind actual checkout bytes. Only these unchanged UTF-8 files differ from their Git blobs by CRLF to LF normalization. Every new or changed payload must match the Git index exactly before publication.
